title: At the Doctor
paragraphs: Rafi mengalami sakit kepala parah dan demam ringan sejak kemarin sore. Setelah mencoba bertahan menjalani hari kerjanya, ia akhirnya memutuskan untuk pulang lebih awal dan mengunjungi klinik kecil dekat apartemennya.

"Ada keluhan apa hari ini?" tanya perawat dengan ramah saat Rafi duduk di hadapannya. "Kepala saya sakit sekali, dan saya merasa panas serta lelah sejak semalam," jelas Rafi sambil memijat pelipisnya.

Perawat dengan lembut memeriksa suhu tubuhnya dan menanyakan beberapa pertanyaan lagi tentang gejalanya dan minggunya. "Kamu hanya perlu istirahat, minum air, dan obat ini dua kali sehari," katanya sambil menuliskan catatan singkat untuknya.

Rafi berterima kasih dan pulang, memutuskan untuk akhirnya benar-benar beristirahat alih-alih mengabaikan sinyal tubuhnya seperti biasanya. Kadang, pikirnya, mengambil cuti sakit adalah pilihan paling bertanggung jawab yang bisa diambil seseorang.
answerKey: Rafi has had a bad headache and a mild fever since yesterday afternoon. After trying to push through his workday, he finally decides to leave the office early and visit a small clinic near his apartment. "What seems to be wrong today?" the nurse asks kindly as Rafi sits down across from her. "My head hurts a lot, and I have felt hot and tired since last night," Rafi explains, rubbing his temples. The nurse gently checks his temperature and asks a few more questions about his symptoms and his week. "You simply need rest, water, and this medicine twice a day," she says, writing a short note for him. Rafi thanks her and heads home, deciding to finally rest properly instead of ignoring his body's signals like he usually does. Sometimes, he thinks, taking a sick day is the most responsible choice a person can make.
